material_correction.problem: Earlier draft framed Premium Pack almost entirely as upholstery preference, omitting documented package additions.
material_correction.change: Research patch v1.3 adds front massage, second-row tray table, CoolHot Box heating/freezing/refrigeration and PM2.5 sensor; standard heated/ventilated front seats, heated steering wheel and heated second row are clearly distinguished.
material_correction.remaining_control: All language versions must use corrected baseline. No temperature, performance, food-preservation, medical-storage or health benefit guarantee.

editorial_findings: Vehicle market, powertrain and named trim/package are identified. Unresolved model-year/production boundaries prohibit numerical specification assertions.
Reviewer impressions are attributed, not fabricated firsthand driving. TIGGO third-row disagreement is retained rather than averaged into a promise.
Guides give purchasing questions, not mechanical adjustment, refrigerant charging or child-restraint installation procedures.
Headlamp MOT/testing examples do not become worldwide import approval; UK warranties/roadside assistance do not become export entitlement.
Fuel E15 percentage is a scoped US guidance statement; no universal AKI/RON conversion is supplied.
Missing compatibility database entries remain unresolved, not proof of safety or incompatibility.
limits: This report describes actual reading only. Mechanical source/length/numeral checks are separate. Full live-site and all historical-language dedup were not available. Source count is not a fact-quality certificate.
additional_corrections: Air-conditioning Chinese title changed from home-country assumption to destination-neutral wording; ND-oil 11 terminology requested consistently.
